run_freeze_dataset_versions: run the script to dump all registered TFDS dataset names and versions into stable_versions.txt
summarize_main: summarize the main function that lists and writes TFDS dataset versions to a text file
review_tfds_core_visibility: review the tfds.core.visibility.set_availables call to filter public datasets
review_tfds_core_load: review the tfds.core.load.list_full_names call to retrieve registered dataset names
review_tfds_core_utils: review the tfds.core.utils.tfds_write_path call to determine the output file path
